title: The First Step of Decision Making: Alignment under Semantic Uncertainty for Automated Operations Research
summary: Problem definition: Automated operations research (OR) depends on correctly understanding the problem users intend to solve. In practice, limited user knowledge and vague expressions can obscure that problem, creating semantic uncertainty in the descriptions used for modeling. This uncertainty can lead to mathematical models that depart from users' intentions. We study semantic alignment to identify and correct errors or omissions in these descriptions before mathematical modeling.
